digest.component_or_area: CLI help generation and routing (_cli/help subsystem)
propositions: Hand-maintained package help artifacts drift from runtime parser factory definitions and must be replaced with canonical generated output deterministic to the registered parser census
Help pre-scan lexical routing (--help, -h, help <cmd>) must complete before operation composition, config parsing, store creation, and handler resolution, cutting help off the main execution ladder
All visible canonical commands must appear exactly once in grouped overview; aliases reuse bytes; compatibility/hidden/retired commands follow approved rendering rules without duplication
Factory enrichment with per-argument help= text, description, epilog, and SUPPRESS directives moves curated prose from hand-authored artifacts into parser definitions for canonical generation

Generator --check mode must fail on missing/stale/stray artifacts, blank summaries, non-deterministic renders, registry/parser mismatch, or any lowercase usage: prefix (capitalized Usage: is the only byte-parity invariant)
